mentions.name: Arkel
mentions.description: Arkel is an object store (S3-style object storage service) that has been in development and testing for a few months, aimed at people who self-host and want reliable backup storage while decreasing reliance on big tech providers.
mentions.problem: Self-hosters are paranoid about backups and often end up relying on big tech services like S3, which the author wanted to avoid.
mentions.audience: Self-hosters who want dependable offsite backups without depending on big tech cloud providers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Arkel is an object store I've been building and testing for the past few months. https://arkeldata.com
mentions.author: conqrr
